note: Glass travel tubes (CITY-108 to CITY-112; F-VEH-TUBE level 2, owner 2026-11-28). How a ride moves. Where the stops and tubes are is map data (World/<city>/tubes.json), not here. All numbers [ASSUMPTION] until the tube reference is approved.

place.note: How far a stop's booth (plinth 1 m round) keeps from the things on and by the street (Tools/citysim/tubes.py booth_clashes(); make_tubes_01.py moves a booth along its pavement until nothing clashes; test_CITY_108_booths_keep_clear_of_the_street). The owner, 2026-11-28: "it's overlapping bus stop etc at some place. these are basic common sense checks". bus_stop_m: from a bus stop's sign, its shelter and the bus at it; door_m / tram_door_m: from a building's (a tram stop's) door; thing_m: from a lamp, bin, bench, sign or plant; big_m: more for the big things; trunk_m: from a tree's trunk; bay_m: from a parking bay's middle; zebra_m: along the street from a zebra crossing; lot_m / market_m: outside a lot (the market's stalls); road_m: from every road's middle, so the plinth stands on the pavement. [ASSUMPTION]

post.note: A post (0.24 m plinth) under a level tube, at least every span_m and never more than max_span_m apart (max_span_over_road_m where the tube crosses a road or passes a crossing and its zebras, where no post can stand); moved along the line up to shift_m to keep clear of the same things as a booth, at these distances, and road_m from every road's middle (on the pavement, not in the road). [ASSUMPTION]

tube_note: The owner, 2026-11-28: "thinner diameter should be just enough fit the player's waist. so the player will rotate laterally when going horizontal". 0.68 m inside: the reference's rider measures 0.63 m across with the arms at the sides. [ASSUMPTION]

look.note: From the approved reference VehiclesGlassTube (Tools/blender/hours_50.py TUBE; the owner, 2026-11-28: "Approve, go on"). Metres; colours linear RGB. glass_edge: how much more the glass covers at a grazing angle than looked through (0.34 in Blender read milky close to the camera in Unreal, 2026-11-28).

bend_note: bend_r_m: each corner of a tube's line is built and ridden as an arc this wide (the reference's bend_r); junction_bend_r_m: where a ride turns from one tube into another at a junction, small enough to stay inside the crossing tubes. [ASSUMPTION]
floor_note: floor_m: the booth's floor over the street (look.plinth_h and its 6 cm step): where a ride starts and where the rider is set down, pop_out_arc_m in from the middle towards the door, inside the booth, facing out. [ASSUMPTION]
